In most zombie movies, the threat is obvious.
The infected, the chaos, the collapse of society.

In this video, I want to talk about why this story feels so different — how it quietly subverts everything we expect from the genre, and why its most disturbing element isn’t the zombies… but a character that feels uncomfortably human.

Because this isn’t really a story about survival.
It’s about what we become when the world falls apart.

And why, in a broken world, the idea of a “hero” might not look the way we expect.
